"""
EasyChatBot AI Operations Center provider health history repository.

Stores provider health observations for operational intelligence.

Architecture:

ProviderHealthObservation
        |
        v
ProviderHealthHistoryRepository
        |
        v
Provider Intelligence Service


Responsibilities:

- store health observations;
- retrieve provider history;
- support operational analytics.

Does NOT:

- execute providers;
- call external APIs;
- modify provider routing;
- create incidents;
- perform remediation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict

from app.application.provider_management.provider_health_models import (
    ProviderHealthObservation,
)


class ProviderHealthHistoryRepository:
    """
    In-memory repository for provider health observations.

    Designed for Beta usage.

    Future persistence can replace this implementation
    without changing application contracts.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._observations: dict[
            str,
            list[ProviderHealthObservation],
        ] = defaultdict(list)


    def save(
        self,
        observation: ProviderHealthObservation,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Store one provider health observation.
        """

        if observation is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Provider health observation cannot be None."
            )

        self._observations[
            observation.provider
        ].append(
            observation
        )


    def get_all(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[ProviderHealthObservation, ...]:
        """
        Return all stored observations.
        """

        result: list[
            ProviderHealthObservation
        ] = []

        for observations in self._observations.values():
            result.extend(observations)

        return tuple(result)


    def get_by_provider(
        self,
        provider: str,
    ) -> tuple[ProviderHealthObservation, ...]:
        """
        Return observations for one provider.
        """

        if not provider.strip():
            raise ValueError(
                "Provider cannot be empty."
            )

        return tuple(
            self._observations.get(
                provider,
                [],
            )
        )


    def latest(
        self,
        provider: str,
    ) -> ProviderHealthObservation | None:
        """
        Return the latest observation for a provider.
        """

        observations = (
            self.get_by_provider(provider)
        )

        if not observations:
            return None

        return observations[-1]


    def count(
        self,
    ) -> int:
        """
        Return total number of stored observations.
        """

        return sum(
            len(items)
            for items
            in self._observations.values()
        )

"""
Agent Manifest Definition.

The AgentManifest describes the identity and basic metadata
of an EasyChatBot AI Agent.

The manifest does not execute the agent.
It only defines:

- what the agent represents

"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

            Unique identifier of the agent.

        name:
            Human-readable agent name.

        description:
            Purpose and responsibility of the agent.

"""
Agent Result Contract.

Defines the standard output returned by AI Agents.

All agents should return the same structure
so the Runtime can process results consistently.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentResult:
    """
    Immutable result returned after agent execution.

    Attributes:
        success:
            Indicates whether execution completed successfully.

        agent_id:
            Identifier of the agent that produced the result.

        output:
            Agent response payload.

        error:
            Error message when execution fails.
    """

    success: bool
    agent_id: str
    output: Any = None
    error: str | None = None

"""
Base AI Agent Contract.

All EasyChatBot AI Agents inherit this contract.

The BaseAgent defines:
- agent identity
- execution interface
- runtime interaction

Agents do not:
- call providers directly
- manage memory
- modify external systems

The AI Runtime controls execution.
"""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import ExecutionContext
from backend.agents.agent_manifest import AgentManifest
from backend.agents.agent_result import AgentResult


class BaseAgent(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for EasyChatBot agents.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        manifest: AgentManifest,
    ):
        """
        Initialise an agent.

        Args:
            manifest:
                Agent identity definition.
        """

        self.manifest = manifest

    @abstractmethod
    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Execute the agent.

        Args:
            context:
                Runtime execution context.

        Returns:
            AgentResult.
        """

        pass

"""
Conversation Agent.

Provides character-aware conversational responses
for the EasyChatBot hackathon runtime.

The agent remains provider-independent.

Architecture:

ExecutionContext
|
v
ConversationAgent
|
+--> CharacterProfile
+--> Optional MemoryContext
+--> Optional IntelligenceContext
|
v
ConversationRequest
|
v
LLMService
|
v
LLMProvider
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.agents.agent_manifest import (
    AgentManifest,
)

from backend.agents.agent_result import (
    AgentResult,
)

from backend.agents.base_agent import (
    BaseAgent,
)

from backend.characters.character_profile import (
    CharacterProfile,
)

from backend.conversation.conversation_request import (
    ConversationRequest,
)

from backend.providers.llm.llm_provider import (
    LLMProvider,
)

from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import (
    ExecutionContext,
)

from backend.services.llm_service import (
    LLMService,
)


class ConversationAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    Character-aware conversation agent.

    The agent consumes the provider-independent
    ExecutionContext.

    Memory and Live Intelligence remain application/runtime
    concerns. The agent only receives their prepared context.
    """

    LIVE_INTELLIGENCE_INSTRUCTION = (
        "When responding using current live intelligence, "
        "create a concise learning brief for the learner. "
        "Do not reproduce articles or provide a long news "
        "summary. Focus only on the most important information. "
        "Keep the main summary between approximately 60 and "
        "100 words. Present no more than three key ideas. "
        "Then briefly explain why the information matters "
        "to the learner. Adapt the language and complexity "
        "to the learner's level and the character's learning "
        "style. Use only information supported by the supplied "
        "live intelligence. Do not invent facts, sources, "
        "statistics, quotations, or URLs. Do not list every "
        "retrieved source in the response. Source metadata is "
        "retained separately by the application."
    )

    def __init__(
        self,
        character: CharacterProfile,
        llm_service: LLMService | None = None,
        llm_provider: LLMProvider | None = None,
    ) -> None:

        super().__init__(
            AgentManifest(
                agent_id="conversation_agent",
                name="Conversation Agent",
                description=(
                    "Provides character-aware "
                    "conversation responses."
                ),
            )
        )

        if (
            llm_service is not None
            and llm_provider is not None
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Provide either llm_service or "
                "llm_provider, not both."
            )

        self.character = character

        if llm_service is not None:
            self.llm_service = llm_service

        elif llm_provider is not None:
            self.llm_service = LLMService(
                llm_provider
            )

        else:
            self.llm_service = None

    def build_request(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> ConversationRequest:
        """
        Build a provider-independent conversation request.

        Memory and intelligence are explicitly represented
        as contextual information.

        Neither is treated as an instruction.
        """

        system_instruction = (
            f"You are {self.character.name}, "
            f"a character in EasyChatBot. "
            f"Your personality is: "
            f"{self.character.personality} "
            f"Your learning style is: "
            f"{self.character.learning_style} "
            f"Communicate in a way that is consistent "
            f"with this character."
        )

        context_sections: list[str] = []

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Learner memory
        # -------------------------------------------------

        if context.has_memory_context:
            memory_text = (
                context.memory_context.text
            )

            if memory_text.strip():
                context_sections.append(
                    "Learner memory context:\n"
                    + memory_text
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Live intelligence
        # -------------------------------------------------

        has_live_intelligence = (
            context.has_intelligence_context
        )

        if has_live_intelligence:
            intelligence_text = (
                context.intelligence_context
                .to_context_text()
            )

            if intelligence_text.strip():
                context_sections.append(
                    "Current live intelligence:\n"
                    + intelligence_text
                )

                context_sections.append(
                    "Live intelligence response rules:\n"
                    + self.LIVE_INTELLIGENCE_INSTRUCTION
                )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # Combined contextual information
        # -------------------------------------------------

        conversation_context = None

        if context_sections:
            conversation_context = (
                "\n\n".join(
                    context_sections
                )
            )

        # -------------------------------------------------
        # User prompt
        # -------------------------------------------------

        user_prompt = context.request

        if has_live_intelligence:
            user_prompt = (
                "Answer the learner's request using "
                "the supplied current live intelligence. "
                "Prioritize a concise learning experience "
                "over information volume.\n\n"
                "Learner request:\n"
                + context.request
            )

        return ConversationRequest(
            system_instruction=system_instruction,
            user_prompt=user_prompt,
            conversation_context=(
                conversation_context
            ),
            character_id=(
                self.character.character_id
            ),
            character_name=(
                self.character.name
            ),
        )

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Execute the conversation agent.
        """

        conversation_request = (
            self.build_request(context)
        )

        provider_result = None

        if self.llm_service is not None:
            provider_result = (
                await self.llm_service.generate(
                    conversation_request
                )
            )

            if not provider_result.success:
                return AgentResult(
                    success=False,
                    agent_id=(
                        self.manifest.agent_id
                    ),
                    output={
                        "character": (
                            self.character.name
                        ),
                        "character_profile": {
                            "character_id": (
                                self.character.character_id
                            ),
                            "name": (
                                self.character.name
                            ),
                            "description": (
                                self.character.description
                            ),
                            "personality": (
                                self.character.personality
                            ),
                            "learning_style": (
                                self.character.learning_style
                            ),
                        },
                        "personality": (
                            self.character.personality
                        ),
                        "learning_style": (
                            self.character.learning_style
                        ),
                        "message": (
                            "The conversation provider "
                            "could not generate a response."
                        ),
                        "intelligence_context": (
                            conversation_request
                            .conversation_context
                        ),
                        "conversation_request": (
                            conversation_request
                        ),
                        "provider_id": (
                            provider_result.provider_id
                        ),
                        "provider_error": (
                            provider_result.error
                        ),
                    },
                )

        if provider_result is not None:
            message = provider_result.output

        else:
            message = (
                f"{self.character.name}: "
                f"Let's explore this together. "
                f"You asked: "
                f"{context.request}"
            )

        output = {
            "character": (
                self.character.name
            ),
            "character_profile": {
                "character_id": (
                    self.character.character_id
                ),
                "name": (
                    self.character.name
                ),
                "description": (
                    self.character.description
                ),
                "personality": (
                    self.character.personality
                ),
                "learning_style": (
                    self.character.learning_style
                ),
            },
            "personality": (
                self.character.personality
            ),
            "learning_style": (
                self.character.learning_style
            ),
            "message": message,
            "intelligence_context": (
                conversation_request
                .conversation_context
            ),
            "conversation_request": (
                conversation_request
            ),
        }

        if provider_result is not None:
            output["provider_id"] = (
                provider_result.provider_id
            )

        return AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id=(
                self.manifest.agent_id
            ),
            output=output,
        )

"""
Cybersecurity Intelligence Agent.

Agent 1 for the EasyChatBot Cybersecurity Operations Center.

Responsibilities:

- orchestrate cybersecurity intelligence skills;
- produce provider-independent decision support.

Does NOT:

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.agents.agent_result import (

from backend.agents.base_agent import (
    BaseAgent,
)

from backend.cybersecurity.intelligence_models import (
    CybersecuritySignal,
)

from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import (
    ExecutionContext,

from backend.skills.skill import (
    SkillInput,
)

from backend.skills.cybersecurity.executive_security_summary import (
    ExecutiveSecuritySummarySkill,
)

from backend.skills.cybersecurity.security_signal_analysis import (
    SecuritySignalAnalysisSkill,
)

from backend.skills.cybersecurity.threat_prioritisation import (
    ThreatPrioritisationSkill,
)


class CybersecurityIntelligenceAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    Stateless Cybersecurity Intelligence Agent.

    Security observations are supplied through the
    ExecutionContext metadata.
    """

    agent_id = "cybersecurity.intelligence"

    name = "Cybersecurity Intelligence Agent"

    version = "1.0.0"

    def __init__(
        self,
        signal_analysis_skill: (
            SecuritySignalAnalysisSkill | None
        ) = None,
        prioritisation_skill: (
            ThreatPrioritisationSkill | None
        ) = None,
        summary_skill: (
            ExecutiveSecuritySummarySkill | None
        ) = None,
    ) -> None:

        self._signal_analysis = (
            signal_analysis_skill
            or SecuritySignalAnalysisSkill()
        )

        self._prioritisation = (
            prioritisation_skill
            or ThreatPrioritisationSkill()
        )

        self._summary = (
            summary_skill
            or ExecutiveSecuritySummarySkill()
        )

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Analyse supplied cybersecurity signals.
        """

        if context is None:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    "Execution context cannot be None."
                ),
            )

        raw_signals = context.metadata.get(
            "cybersecurity_signals"
        )

        if raw_signals is None:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    "cybersecurity_signals are required "
                    "in execution metadata."
                ),
            )

        if not isinstance(
            raw_signals,
            (list, tuple),
        ):
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    "cybersecurity_signals must be "
                    "a list or tuple."
                ),
            )

        signals = [
            item
            for item in raw_signals
            if isinstance(
                item,
                CybersecuritySignal,
            )
        ]

        analysis_result = await (
            self._signal_analysis.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=context.request,
                    metadata={
                        "signals": signals,
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not analysis_result.success:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    analysis_result.error
                    or "Signal analysis failed."
                ),
            )

        prioritisation_result = await (
            self._prioritisation.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=context.request,
                    metadata={
                        "analysed_signals": (
                            analysis_result.output
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not prioritisation_result.success:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    prioritisation_result.error
                    or "Threat prioritisation failed."
                ),
            )

        summary_result = await (
            self._summary.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=context.request,
                    metadata={
                        "prioritised_signals": (
                            prioritisation_result.output
                        ),
                        "execution_id": (
                            context.execution_id
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not summary_result.success:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    summary_result.error
                    or "Executive summary failed."
                ),
            )

        summary = summary_result.output

        if not isinstance(summary, dict):
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=(
                    "Executive security summary "
                    "returned an invalid output."
                ),
            )

        return AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id=self.agent_id,
            output={
                # Primary API/UI contract.
                "signal_count": summary.get(
                    "signal_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "open_signal_count": summary.get(
                    "open_signal_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "critical_count": summary.get(
                    "critical_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "high_count": summary.get(
                    "high_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "medium_count": summary.get(
                    "medium_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "low_count": summary.get(
                    "low_count",
                    0,
                ),
                "posture": summary.get(
                    "posture",
                    "UNKNOWN",
                ),
                "priority_signals": summary.get(
                    "priority_signals",
                    [],
                ),
                "decision_note": summary.get(
                    "decision_note",
                    "",
                ),
                "execution_id": summary.get(
                    "execution_id"
                ),

                # Internal diagnostic information.
                "analysis": analysis_result.output,
                "prioritised_signals": (
                    prioritisation_result.output
                ),
            },
        )

"""
Research Agent.

Retrieves external information through approved
knowledge providers and converts the result into
provider-independent IntelligenceContext data.

Architecture:

Research Agent
        |
        v
ParallelSearchProvider
        |
        v
ParallelClientWrapper
        |
        v
IntelligenceContext
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from backend.agents.agent_manifest import AgentManifest
from backend.agents.agent_result import AgentResult
from backend.agents.base_agent import BaseAgent

from backend.intelligence.intelligence_context import (
    IntelligenceContext,
    IntelligenceSource,
)

from backend.providers.parallel.parallel_provider import (
    ParallelSearchProvider,
)

from backend.runtime.context.execution_context import (
    ExecutionContext,
)


class ResearchAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    Agent responsible for world information retrieval.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        provider=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(
            AgentManifest(
                agent_id="research_agent",
                name="Research Agent",
                description=(
                    "Retrieves live world information "
                    "for AI learning experiences."
                ),
            )
        )

        self.provider = (
            provider
            or ParallelSearchProvider()
        )

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Execute research and produce a normalized
        IntelligenceContext.
        """

        result = await self.provider.execute(
            context
        )

        if not result.success:
            return AgentResult(
                success=False,
                agent_id=self.manifest.agent_id,
                output=None,
                error=result.error,
            )

        intelligence = (
            self._build_intelligence_context(
                query=context.request,
                provider_output=result.output,
            )
        )

        return AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id=self.manifest.agent_id,
            output=intelligence,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _build_intelligence_context(
        query: str,
        provider_output,
    ) -> IntelligenceContext:
        """
        Convert provider output into the
        provider-independent IntelligenceContext.
        """

        if not isinstance(
            provider_output,
            dict,
        ):
            raise TypeError(
                "Research provider output must be a dictionary."
            )

        raw_results = provider_output.get(
            "results",
            {},
        )

        if isinstance(
            raw_results,
            dict,
        ):
            raw_results = raw_results.get(
                "results",
                [],
            )

        if not isinstance(
            raw_results,
            list,
        ):
            raw_results = []

        sources: list[IntelligenceSource] = []

        for raw_result in raw_results:

            if not isinstance(
                raw_result,
                dict,
            ):
                continue

            title = str(
                raw_result.get(
                    "title",
                    "",
                )
            ).strip()

            url = str(
                raw_result.get(
                    "url",
                    "",
                )
            ).strip()

            if not title or not url:
                continue

            content = ResearchAgent._extract_content(
                raw_result
            )

            sources.append(
                IntelligenceSource(
                    title=title,
                    url=url,
                    source="parallel",
                    content=content,
                )
            )

        return IntelligenceContext(
            query=query,
            sources=tuple(sources),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _extract_content(
        raw_result: dict,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Extract available content from a normalized
        Parallel result.
        """

        excerpts = raw_result.get(
            "excerpts",
        )

        if excerpts is None:
            excerpts = raw_result.get(
                "snippet",
                raw_result.get(
                    "content",
                    "",
                ),
            )

        if isinstance(
            excerpts,
            list,
        ):
            return "\n\n".join(
                str(item).strip()
                for item in excerpts
                if str(item).strip()
            )

        return str(
            excerpts or ""
        ).strip()

"""
Discovery Agent.

Owns the complete Beta 1 personalised discovery workflow.

The Discovery Agent orchestrates nine bounded Discovery Skills:

1. Preference Understanding
2. Discovery Query Generation
3. Content/Product Discovery
4. Relevance Matching
5. Recommendation Ranking
6. Recommendation Explanation
7. Personalised Content Adaptation
8. Discovery Quality Verification
9. User Choice & Controlled Handoff

The Discovery Agent:

- receives Runtime ExecutionContext
- obtains approved preferences through PreferenceSource
- executes Skills explicitly and sequentially
- passes provider-independent outputs between Skills
- preserves the Runtime boundary
- stops at the explicit learner-choice boundary
- creates a controlled handoff only after explicit selection
- returns the standard AgentResult contract

The Discovery Agent does not:

- call provider SDKs directly
- bypass the Runtime
- persist memory
- modify learner preferences
- perform uncontrolled external actions
- purchase products
- automatically select recommendations

Preference architecture:

ExecutionContext
|
v
PreferenceSource
|
v
PreferenceContext
|
v
PreferenceUnderstandingSkill
|
v
DiscoveryProfile
|
v
QueryGenerationSkill
|
v
DiscoveryQuery[]
|
v
ContentProductDiscoverySkill
|
v
DiscoveryCandidate[]
|
v
RelevanceMatchingSkill
|
v
RelevanceMatch[]
|
v
RecommendationRankingSkill
|
v
RankedRecommendation[]
|
v
RecommendationExplanationSkill
|
v
RecommendationExplanation[]
|
v
PersonalisedContentAdaptationSkill
|
v
PersonalisedRecommendation[]
|
v
DiscoveryQualityVerificationSkill
|
v
VerifiedRecommendation[]
|
v
UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill
|
+--> awaiting_user_choice
|
v
Explicit learner selection
|
v
Controlled handoff
"""

from typing import Any

from backend.agents.agent_manifest import AgentManifest
from backend.agents.agent_result import AgentResult

class DiscoveryAgent(BaseAgent):
    """
    Beta 1 Discovery Agent.

    Owns orchestration of the nine Discovery Skills.

    Preferences remain behind PreferenceSource.

    External discovery remains behind
    ContentProductDiscoverySkill and its DiscoveryGateway.

    The Agent itself never calls an external provider SDK.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        preference_skill: (
            PreferenceUnderstandingSkill | None
        ) = None,
        preference_source: (
            PreferenceSource | None
        ) = None,
        query_generation_skill: (
            DiscoveryQueryGenerationSkill | None
        ) = None,
        discovery_skill: (
            ContentProductDiscoverySkill | None
        ) = None,
        relevance_matching_skill: (
            RelevanceMatchingSkill | None
        ) = None,
        recommendation_ranking_skill: (
            RecommendationRankingSkill | None
        ) = None,
        recommendation_explanation_skill: (
            RecommendationExplanationSkill | None
        ) = None,
        personalised_content_adaptation_skill: (
            PersonalisedContentAdaptationSkill | None
        ) = None,
        quality_verification_skill: (
            DiscoveryQualityVerificationSkill | None
        ) = None,
        user_choice_handoff_skill: (
            UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill | None
        ) = None,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Initialise the Discovery Agent.

        All Skills are injectable for deterministic testing and
        controlled Runtime composition.

        ContentProductDiscoverySkill remains optional for backward
        compatibility with the existing preference-only workflow.

        When it is not supplied, the Agent stops after producing
        the DiscoveryProfile.

        When it is supplied, the complete Beta 1 discovery pipeline
        is executed.
        """

        super().__init__(
            AgentManifest(
                agent_id="discovery_agent",
                name="Discovery Agent",
                description=(
                    "Discovers and personalises podcasts, "
                    "news, products and related content "
                    "according to approved learner "
                    "preferences."
                ),
                version="1.0.0",
            )
        )

        self.preference_skill = (
            preference_skill
            if preference_skill is not None
            else PreferenceUnderstandingSkill()
        )

        self.preference_source = (
            preference_source
            if preference_source is not None
            else HackathonPreferenceSource()
        )

        self.query_generation_skill = (
            query_generation_skill
            if query_generation_skill is not None
            else DiscoveryQueryGenerationSkill()
        )

        self.discovery_skill = (
            discovery_skill
            if discovery_skill is not None
            else None
        )

        self.relevance_matching_skill = (
            relevance_matching_skill
            if relevance_matching_skill is not None
            else RelevanceMatchingSkill()
        )

        self.recommendation_ranking_skill = (
            recommendation_ranking_skill
            if recommendation_ranking_skill is not None
            else RecommendationRankingSkill()
        )

        self.recommendation_explanation_skill = (
            recommendation_explanation_skill
            if recommendation_explanation_skill is not None
            else RecommendationExplanationSkill()
        )

        self.personalised_content_adaptation_skill = (
            personalised_content_adaptation_skill
            if personalised_content_adaptation_skill is not None
            else PersonalisedContentAdaptationSkill()
        )

        self.quality_verification_skill = (
            quality_verification_skill
            if quality_verification_skill is not None
            else DiscoveryQualityVerificationSkill()
        )

        self.user_choice_handoff_skill = (
            user_choice_handoff_skill
            if user_choice_handoff_skill is not None
            else UserChoiceControlledHandoffSkill()
        )

    async def execute(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Execute the Discovery workflow.

        Backward-compatible mode:

            PreferenceSource
                â†“
            PreferenceUnderstandingSkill
                â†“
            DiscoveryProfile

        Full Beta 1 mode:

            Preference Understanding
                â†“
            Query Generation
                â†“
            Content/Product Discovery
                â†“
            Relevance Matching
                â†“
            Recommendation Ranking
                â†“
            Recommendation Explanation
                â†“
            Personalised Content Adaptation
                â†“
            Quality Verification
                â†“
            User Choice / Controlled Handoff

        The full pipeline is activated when a
        ContentProductDiscoverySkill is injected.

        No recommendation is automatically selected.
        """

        validation_error = self._validate_context(
            context
        )

        if validation_error is not None:
            return validation_error

        request = context.request.strip()

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 1 â€” Obtain approved learner preferences
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        try:
            preference_context = (
                await self.preference_source.get_preferences(
                    context.user_id
                )
            )

        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            return self._failure(
                "Preference source failed: "
                f"{exc}"
            )

        if not isinstance(
            preference_context,
            PreferenceContext,
        ):
            return self._failure(
                "Preference source returned an invalid "
                "PreferenceContext."
            )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 2 â€” Preference Understanding
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        preference_result = (
            await self.preference_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    memory_context=None,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "preference_context": (
                            preference_context
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not preference_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                preference_result
            )

        profile = preference_result.output

        if not isinstance(
            profile,
            DiscoveryProfile,
        ):
            return self._failure(
                "Preference Understanding returned an "
                "invalid DiscoveryProfile."
            )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Backward compatibility
        #
        # Existing Discovery Agent consumers and tests use the
        # Agent with only PreferenceSource injected.
        #
        # Do not force external discovery infrastructure onto
        # those callers.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        if self.discovery_skill is None:
            return AgentResult(
                success=True,
                agent_id=self.manifest.agent_id,
                output={
                    "discovery_profile": (
                        profile.as_dict()
                    ),
                    "preference_context": (
                        self._preference_context_dict(
                            preference_context
                        )
                    ),
                    "skills_executed": [
                        preference_result.skill_id,
                    ],
                    "status": "profile_ready",
                },
            )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 3 â€” Discovery Query Generation
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        query_result = (
            await self.query_generation_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "discovery_profile": profile,
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not query_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                query_result
            )

        discovery_queries = query_result.output

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 4 â€” Content/Product Discovery
        #
        # External discovery remains behind the injected
        # DiscoveryGateway-backed Skill.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        discovery_result = (
            await self.discovery_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "discovery_queries": (
                            discovery_queries
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not discovery_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                discovery_result
            )

        candidates = discovery_result.output

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 5 â€” Relevance Matching
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        relevance_result = (
            await self.relevance_matching_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "discovery_profile": profile,
                        "discovery_candidates": candidates,
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not relevance_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                relevance_result
            )

        relevance_matches = relevance_result.output

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 6 â€” Recommendation Ranking
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        ranking_result = (
            await self.recommendation_ranking_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "relevance_matches": (
                            relevance_matches
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not ranking_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                ranking_result
            )

        ranked_recommendations = (
            ranking_result.output
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 7 â€” Recommendation Explanation
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        explanation_result = (
            await self.recommendation_explanation_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "ranked_recommendations": (
                            ranked_recommendations
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not explanation_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                explanation_result
            )

        recommendation_explanations = (
            explanation_result.output
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 8 â€” Personalised Content Adaptation
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        adaptation_result = (
            await self.personalised_content_adaptation_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "discovery_profile": profile,
                        "recommendation_explanations": (
                            recommendation_explanations
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not adaptation_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                adaptation_result
            )

        personalised_recommendations = (
            adaptation_result.output
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 9 â€” Discovery Quality Verification
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        quality_result = (
            await self.quality_verification_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "personalised_recommendations": (
                            personalised_recommendations
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not quality_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                quality_result
            )

        quality_output = quality_result.output

        if not isinstance(
            quality_output,
            dict,
        ):
            return self._failure(
                "Discovery Quality Verification returned "
                "an invalid output."
            )

        verified_recommendations = (
            quality_output.get(
                "verified",
                [],
            )
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Step 10 â€” User Choice & Controlled Handoff
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        selected_option_id = (
            context.metadata.get(
                "selected_option_id"
            )
        )

        handoff_result = (
            await self.user_choice_handoff_skill.execute(
                SkillInput(
                    request=request,
                    user_id=context.user_id,
                    metadata={
                        "execution_id": context.execution_id,
                        "verified_recommendations": (
                            verified_recommendations
                        ),
                        "selected_option_id": (
                            selected_option_id
                        ),
                    },
                )
            )
        )

        if not handoff_result.success:
            return self._skill_failure(
                handoff_result
            )

        handoff_output = handoff_result.output

        if not isinstance(
            handoff_output,
            dict,
        ):
            return self._failure(
                "User Choice Controlled Handoff returned "
                "an invalid output."
            )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # Final AgentResult
        #
        # Preserve domain objects at the Agent boundary.
        #
        # Transport serialization belongs to the application/API
        # boundary. In particular, ControlledHandoff must remain a
        # domain object so consumers can use its explicit contract.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

        return AgentResult(
            success=True,
            agent_id=self.manifest.agent_id,
            output={
                "status": handoff_output.get(
                    "status"
                ),
                "discovery_profile": (
                    profile.as_dict()
                ),
                "preference_context": (
                    self._preference_context_dict(
                        preference_context
                    )
                ),
                "discovery_queries": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        discovery_queries
                    )
                ),
                "candidates": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        candidates
                    )
                ),
                "relevance_matches": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        relevance_matches
                    )
                ),
                "ranked_recommendations": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        ranked_recommendations
                    )
                ),
                "recommendation_explanations": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        recommendation_explanations
                    )
                ),
                "personalised_recommendations": (
                    self._serialise_items(
                        personalised_recommendations
                    )
                ),
                "quality": (
                    self._serialise_value(
                        quality_output
                    )
                ),

                # Handoff options are intentionally preserved
                # as domain objects for the learner-choice
                # boundary.
                "options": (
                    handoff_output.get(
                        "options",
                        [],
                    )
                ),

                # ControlledHandoff must remain the domain
                # object rather than being converted to a dict.
                "handoff": (
                    handoff_output.get(
                        "handoff"
                    )
                ),

                # Preserve the complete Skill output for
                # compatibility with existing consumers.
                "user_choice": handoff_output,

                "skills_executed": [
                    preference_result.skill_id,
                    query_result.skill_id,
                    discovery_result.skill_id,
                    relevance_result.skill_id,
                    ranking_result.skill_id,
                    explanation_result.skill_id,
                    adaptation_result.skill_id,
                    quality_result.skill_id,
                    handoff_result.skill_id,
                ],
            },
        )

    def _validate_context(
        self,
        context: ExecutionContext | None,
    ) -> AgentResult | None:
        """
        Validate the Runtime execution context.
        """

        if context is None:
            return self._failure(
                "Execution context cannot be None."
            )

        if not isinstance(
            context.request,
            str,
        ):
            return self._failure(
                "Execution context request must be a string."
            )

        if not context.request.strip():
            return self._failure(
                "Execution context request cannot be empty."
            )

        return None

    def _failure(
        self,
        error: str,
        *,
        output: Any = None,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Create a standard failed AgentResult.
        """

        return AgentResult(
            success=False,
            agent_id=self.manifest.agent_id,
            output=output,
            error=error,
        )

    def _skill_failure(
        self,
        skill_result: Any,
    ) -> AgentResult:
        """
        Convert a failed SkillResult into AgentResult.
        """

        return self._failure(
            (
                f"Skill '{skill_result.skill_id}' failed: "
                f"{skill_result.error}"
            ),
            output={
                "skill_id": skill_result.skill_id,
                "error": skill_result.error,
            },
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _preference_context_dict(
        preference_context: PreferenceContext,
    ) -> dict[str, object]:
        """
        Convert PreferenceContext into a serialisable payload.
        """

        return {
            "topics": list(
                preference_context.topics
            ),
            "content_types": list(
                preference_context.content_types
            ),
            "languages": list(
                preference_context.languages
            ),
            "learning_level": (
                preference_context.learning_level
            ),
            "source": preference_context.source,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _serialise_value(
        value: Any,
    ) -> Any:
        """
        Convert Skill output objects into transport-safe data.

        Objects exposing as_dict() use that contract.

        Lists, tuples and dictionaries are recursively serialised.
        """

        if hasattr(
            value,
            "as_dict",
        ):
            return value.as_dict()

        if isinstance(
            value,
            (list, tuple),
        ):
            return [
                DiscoveryAgent._serialise_value(
                    item
                )
                for item in value
            ]

        if isinstance(
            value,
            dict,
        ):
            return {
                key: DiscoveryAgent._serialise_value(
                    item
                )
                for key, item in value.items()
            }

        return value

    @staticmethod
    def _serialise_items(
        values: Any,
    ) -> list[Any]:
        """
        Serialise a sequence of Skill outputs.
        """

        if not isinstance(
            values,
            (list, tuple),
        ):
            return []

        return [
            DiscoveryAgent._serialise_value(
                value
            )
            for value in values
        ]

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool

# Load the repository-level .env before accessing DATABASE_URL.
# Repository root:
# C:\AI Folder\EasyChatBot-Hackathon\.env
load_dotenv(
    os.path.abspath(
        os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", ".env")
    )
)

# Make backend/ importable so Alembic can load the application modules.
sys.path.insert(
    0,
    os.path.abspath(
        os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")
    ),
)

from app.infrastructure.persistence.database import Base, database_url
from app.infrastructure.persistence import beta_access_models  # noqa: F401


config = context.config

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def get_database_url() -> str:
    """Return the configured database URL."""
    return database_url()


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    """Run migrations without creating a database connection."""
    url = get_database_url()

    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    """Run migrations using a live database connection."""
    configuration = config.get_section(config.config_ini_section) or {}
    configuration["sqlalchemy.url"] = get_database_url()

    connectable = engine_from_config(
        configuration,
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=target_metadata,
            compare_type=True,
        )

        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

# Selectable Character Endpoint
# =========================================================

@router.get("/selectable")
def get_selectable_characters():
    """
    Return characters currently available for learner
    selection.

    A character is selectable only when:

    - artwork is available;
    - artwork status is approved;
    - selectable is True.

    The learner's existing companion is NOT changed by
    this endpoint.

    This endpoint only provides the catalogue used by
    future character-selection experiences.
    """

    characters = (
        character_registry
        .list_selectable_characters()
    )

    return {
        "characters": [
            {
                "id": character.character_id,
                "name": character.name,
                "description": character.description,
                "personality": character.personality,
                "learning_style": (
                    character.learning_style
                ),
                "artwork_available": (
                    character.artwork_available
                ),
                "artwork_status": (
                    character.artwork_status
                ),
                "selectable": (
                    character.selectable
                ),
            }
            for character in characters
        ]
    }

"""
EasyChatBot Character Theme API.

Bridges the existing Character Registry with the
Character Theme System.

This module does not own learner state.

It only resolves the visual presentation for an
already-selected character.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from app.character_theme_system.application.theme_resolver import (
    CharacterThemeResolver,
)
from app.character_theme_system.configuration.theme_loader import (
    CharacterThemeLoader,
)


class CharacterThemeService:
    """
    Resolve EasyChatBot dashboard themes.

    Character identity remains owned by the backend
    CharacterRegistry.

    Visual presentation remains owned by the
    Character Theme System.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        themes_directory: Path,
    ) -> None:
        self._loader = CharacterThemeLoader.from_directory(
            themes_directory=themes_directory,
        )

        self._resolver = CharacterThemeResolver(
            loader=self._loader,
        )

    def resolve(
        self,
        *,
        character_id: str,
        world_id: str,
        primary_language: str,
        secondary_language: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Resolve a dashboard theme.

        The learner's selected character/world/languages
        are inputs only. This service does not persist
        them.
        """

        result = self._resolver.resolve(
            character_id=character_id,
            world_id=world_id,
            primary_language=primary_language,
            secondary_language=secondary_language,
        )

        return {
            "character_id": result.character_id,
            "world_id": result.world_id,
            "languages": {
                "primary": result.context.primary_language,
                "secondary": (
                    result.context.secondary_language
                ),
            },
            "theme": result.theme,
        }

"""
EasyChatBot Character Theme API Routes.

Dedicated HTTP boundary for the Character Theme System.

This router is intentionally separate from backend.api.routes
and the Character Catalogue API.

Responsibilities:

- receive character/world/language context;
- resolve the corresponding visual theme;
- return the resolved theme to the frontend.

This router does NOT:

- manage learner character selection;
- store learner state;
- execute agents;
- execute capabilities;
- create providers.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi import HTTPException

from backend.api.character_theme import (
    CharacterThemeService,
)


router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/character-theme",
    tags=["character-theme"],
)


# =========================================================
# Character Theme Service
# =========================================================

_theme_directory = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    / "app"
    / "configuration"
    / "character_themes"
    / "themes"
)


character_theme_service = CharacterThemeService(
    themes_directory=_theme_directory,
)


# =========================================================
# Character Theme Endpoint
# =========================================================

@router.get("")
def get_character_theme(
    character_id: str,
    world_id: str,
    primary_language: str,
    secondary_language: str | None = None,
):
    """
    Resolve the visual theme for a character/world/language
    context.

    This endpoint does not store learner state.

    It only resolves presentation from the supplied context.
    """

    if not character_id.strip():

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="character_id is required",
        )


    if not world_id.strip():

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="world_id is required",
        )


    if not primary_language.strip():

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="primary_language is required",
        )


    try:

        return character_theme_service.resolve(
            character_id=character_id,
            world_id=world_id,
            primary_language=primary_language,
            secondary_language=secondary_language,
        )


    except FileNotFoundError as exc:

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=404,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc


    except ValueError as exc:

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc


    except Exception as exc:

        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail="Unable to resolve character theme.",
        ) from exc

"""
EasyChatBot API Application.

Hosts the user interaction layer.

The API application is responsible only for:

- creating the FastAPI application;
- registering API routes;
- exposing the application health endpoint;
- triggering application composition bootstrap during startup;
- allowing the local frontend to communicate with the API.

Business logic belongs to application services.

Agent execution belongs to the agent/runtime layer.

Provider construction belongs to the composition layer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from backend.api.routes import router
from backend.api.character_theme_routes import (
    router as character_theme_router,
)
from backend.api.character_routes import (
    router as character_router,
)

from backend.application.bootstrap import (
    bootstrap_application,
)

from backend.application.telegram_bootstrap import (
    start_telegram_runtime,
    stop_telegram_runtime,
)

from app.interfaces.provider_management.operations_center_dashboard_router import (
    router as operations_center_dashboard_router,
)

from backend.app.api.cybersecurity_intelligence import (
    router as cybersecurity_intelligence_router,
)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(
    application: FastAPI,
):
    """
    Manage application startup and shutdown lifecycle.

    Startup:
        - compose application dependencies;
        - start Telegram transport runtime.

    Shutdown:
        - stop Telegram transport runtime.

    This layer does not:

    - execute agents;
    - execute capabilities;
    - create providers;
    - create Runtime components.
    """

    bootstrap_application()

    await start_telegram_runtime()

    try:
        yield

    finally:
        await stop_telegram_runtime()


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    """
    Create the EasyChatBot FastAPI application.

    Application composition is intentionally separated
    from the HTTP layer.

    This function:

    - creates the FastAPI application;
    - configures local frontend access;
    - registers API routes;
    - attaches lifecycle management.

    It does not:

    - execute agents;
    - execute capabilities;
    - call providers directly;
    - create Runtime executors.
    """

    application = FastAPI(
        title="EasyChatBot",
        description="AI companion learning platform",
        lifespan=lifespan,
    )

    # =========================================================
    # Local Frontend CORS
    # =========================================================

    application.add_middleware(
        CORSMiddleware,
        allow_origins=[
            "http://127.0.0.1:5500",
            "http://localhost:5500",
            "http://127.0.0.1:5501",
            "http://localhost:5501",
            "http://localhost:3000",
            "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
        ],
        allow_credentials=True,
        allow_methods=["*"],
        allow_headers=["*"],
    )

    # =========================================================
    # Existing API Routes
    # =========================================================

    application.include_router(
        router,
    )

    # =========================================================
    # Character Theme Routes
    # =========================================================

    application.include_router(
        character_theme_router,
    )

    # =========================================================
    # Character Catalogue Routes
    # =========================================================

    application.include_router(
        character_router,
    )

    # =========================================================
    # AI Operations Center Routes
    # =========================================================

    application.include_router(
        operations_center_dashboard_router,
    )

    # =========================================================
    # Cybersecurity Intelligence Routes
    # =========================================================

    application.include_router(
        cybersecurity_intelligence_router,
    )

    return application


app = create_app()


@app.get("/")
def health() -> dict[str, str]:
    """
    Return application health status.
    """

    return {
        "status": "EasyChatBot running",
        "architecture": (
            "Runtime + Agents + Memory"
        ),
    }

"""
EasyChatBot API Routes.

Application HTTP boundary.

Responsibilities:

- expose HTTP endpoints;
- validate transport input;
- delegate to application services.

This module does not:

- compose Runtime;
- create providers;
- execute agents directly;
- implement capability logic.

Architecture:

API
 |
 v
Application Services
 |
 +--> CompanionService
 |
 +--> RuntimeApplicationService
 |
 v
ExternalRuntimeService
 |
 v
CapabilityGateway
"""

    """
    Deterministic Live Intelligence placeholder.

    Used when API tests execute without application bootstrap.

    No external services are called.
    """

    async def execute(
        self,
        context,
    ) -> dict:
        return {
            "status": "completed",
            "source": "test",
            "context": context,
        }

# =========================================================
# Runtime Service Configuration
# =========================================================

_external_runtime_service_override: (
    ExternalRuntimeService | None
) = None


def configure_external_runtime_service(
    service: ExternalRuntimeService,
) -> None:
    """
    Configure an explicit Runtime service override.

    Primarily used by application tests and controlled
    application composition.

    Production Runtime ownership remains with:

        backend.runtime.external_runtime_container
    """

    global _external_runtime_service_override

    if service is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "ExternalRuntimeService cannot be None."
        )

    _external_runtime_service_override = service


def create_external_runtime_service() -> ExternalRuntimeService:
    """
    Retrieve the configured Runtime service.

    Resolution order:

    1. Explicit test/application override.
    2. Runtime container.
    3. Controlled in-memory Runtime fallback.

    The fallback exists only so API tests can execute
    without requiring full application bootstrap.
    """

    if (
        _external_runtime_service_override
        is not None
    ):
        return _external_runtime_service_override

    try:
        return get_external_runtime_service()

    except RuntimeError:
        gateway = create_external_runtime_gateway(
            live_intelligence_agent=(
                TestLiveIntelligenceAgent()
            ),
            podcast_discovery_agent=(
                _create_test_podcast_agent()
            ),
            podcast_providers=[
                _create_test_podcast_provider()
            ],
            governance=(
                _create_test_governance()
            ),
        )

        return (
            application_factory
            .create_external_runtime_service(
                gateway=gateway,
            )
        )


def create_runtime_application_service(
) -> RuntimeApplicationService:
    """
    Create the application-layer Runtime service.

    API routes remain unaware of Runtime composition.
    """

    return (
        application_factory
        .create_runtime_application_service(
            runtime_service=(
                create_external_runtime_service()
            ),
        )
    )

def create_llm_service() -> LLMService:
    """
    Create the configured LLM application service.
    """

    provider = LLMProviderFactory.create()

    return LLMService(
        provider,
    )


def create_companion_service(
    character,
) -> CompanionService:
    """
    Create CompanionService for a selected character.
    """

    llm_service = create_llm_service()

    agent = ConversationAgent(
        character=character,
        llm_service=llm_service,
    )

    return CompanionService(
        character=character,
        conversation_agent=agent,
    )

@router.get("/characters")
def get_characters():
    """
    Return the available learner characters.
    """

    characters = (
        character_registry.list_characters()
    )

    return {
        "characters": [
            {
                "id": character.character_id,
                "name": character.name,
                "description": character.description,
                "personality": character.personality,
                "learning_style": (
                    character.learning_style
                ),
            }
            for character in characters
        ]
    }


# =========================================================
# Chat Endpoint
# =========================================================


@router.post(
    "/chat",
    response_model=ChatResponse,
)
async def chat(
    payload: ChatRequest,
) -> ChatResponse:
    """
    Execute a Companion conversation.
    """

    if (
        payload.message is None
        or not payload.message.strip()
    ):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="message is required",
        )

    try:
        character = character_registry.get(
            payload.character,
        )

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

    service = create_companion_service(
        character,
    )

    context = ExecutionContext(
        user_id=payload.user_id,
        request=payload.message,
    )

    result = await service.interact(
        context,
        use_research=payload.research,
    )

    return ChatResponse(
        character=result["character"],
        conversation=result["conversation"],
        research=result["research"],
        quality=result["quality"],
        memory_count=result["memory_count"],
        memory_context_count=result.get(
            "memory_context_count",
            0,
        ),
    )


# =========================================================
# Runtime Execute Endpoint
# =========================================================


@router.post(
    "/runtime/execute",
    response_model=RuntimeExecuteResponse,
)
async def execute_runtime(
    payload: RuntimeExecuteRequest,
) -> RuntimeExecuteResponse:
    """
    Execute an approved Runtime capability.

    HTTP concerns remain here.

    Runtime orchestration remains in:

        RuntimeApplicationService
    """

    service = create_runtime_application_service()

    try:
        result = await service.execute(
            capability=payload.capability,
            payload=payload.payload,
        )

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return RuntimeExecuteResponse(
            request_id=result["request_id"],
            capability=result["capability"],
            status=result["status"],
            output=result.get("output"),
            error=result.get("error"),
        )

    return RuntimeExecuteResponse(
        request_id=result.request_id,
        capability=result.capability,
        status=result.status,
        output=result.output,
        error=getattr(
            result,
            "error",
            None,
        ),
    )


# =========================================================
# Podcast Discovery Endpoint
# =========================================================


@router.post(
    "/capabilities/podcast/discover",
)
async def discover_podcast(
    payload: dict,
):
    """
    Execute Podcast Discovery through the Runtime.

    The endpoint only prepares transport-level defaults.
    Discovery remains owned by the Runtime capability.
    """

    if not payload.get("query"):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="query is required",
        )

    service = create_runtime_application_service()

    enriched_payload = {
        "user_id": payload.get(
            "user_id",
            "demo-user",
        ),
        "character_id": payload.get(
            "character_id",
            "yeti",
        ),
        "character_name": payload.get(
            "character_name",
            "Yeti",
        ),
        "character_message": payload.get(
            "character_message",
            (
                "Help me discover useful "
                "learning content."
            ),
        ),
        **payload,
    }

    try:
        result = await service.execute(
            capability="podcast_discovery",
            payload=enriched_payload,
        )

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=str(exc),
        ) from exc

    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return {
            "request_id": result["request_id"],
            "capability": result["capability"],
            "status": result["status"],
            "output": result.get("output"),
        }

    return {
        "request_id": result.request_id,
        "capability": result.capability,
        "status": result.status,
        "output": result.output,
    }

    """

     |

            status=result["status"],

            output=result.get("output"),
            request_id=result["request_id"],

# =========================================================
# Hackathon Flash Deal Card Endpoint
# =========================================================


@router.get(
    "/hackathon/flash-deal",
    response_model=FlashDealResponse,
)
def hackathon_flash_deal() -> FlashDealResponse:
    """
    Return the deterministic hackathon Flash Deal Card.

    Flow:

    Demo Deal
        |
        v
    Demo Memory
        |
        v
    DiscoveryRequest
        |
        v
    DiscoveryService
        |
        v
    FlashDealCard
        |
        v
    HTTP Response

    This endpoint is intentionally deterministic for the
    hackathon frontend integration.

    It does not:

    - perform external discovery;
    - call provider SDKs;
    - process payments;
    - create purchases;
    - bypass Runtime controls;
    - invent product data outside the demo builder.

    The existing FlashDealCard remains the application-facing
    presentation contract. This route only adapts it to HTTP.
    """

    deal = build_demo_deal()

    memory = build_demo_memory()

    request = DiscoveryRequest(
        user_id=memory.user_id,
        deal=deal,
        character=CharacterContext(
            character_id="yeti",
            character_name="Yeti",
            message=(
                "Look what I found! "
                "This could be perfect for you."
            ),
        ),
        product_image_url=(
            "https://example.com/demo/iphone17-pro.jpg"
        ),
        tagline="Pro. Beautiful. Powerful.",
        highlights=(
            "Pro camera system",
            "High-performance chip",
            "All-day battery life",
            "Premium display",
        ),
    )

    card = DiscoveryService().create_flash_deal(
        request,
        memories=[memory],
    )

    return FlashDealResponse(
        deal_id=card.deal_id,

        character=FlashDealCharacterResponse(
            id=card.character_id,
            name=card.character_name,
            message=card.character_message,
        ),

        product=FlashDealProductResponse(
            name=card.product_name,
            image_url=card.product_image_url,
            tagline=card.tagline,
            highlights=list(card.highlights),
        ),

        pricing=FlashDealPricingResponse(
            current_price=card.current_price,
            currency=card.currency,
            previous_price=card.previous_price,
            discount_percentage=(
                card.discount_percentage
            ),
            savings=card.savings,
        ),

        relevance_reason=(
            card.relevance_reason
        ),

        vendor=card.vendor_name,

        actions=FlashDealActionsResponse(
            get_deal=card.get_deal_url,
            more_information=(
                card.more_information_url
            ),
        ),
    )
