"""
Tests for Voice Call Notification Repository.

Validates the repository contract.

Responsibilities tested:
- Save notification.
- Retrieve notification.
- Delete notification.

The concrete infrastructure
implementation is tested separately.
"""

from datetime import (
    datetime,
    timedelta,
    timezone,
)


import pytest


from app.application.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification_repository import (
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
)


from app.domain.uai.notifications.voice_call_notification import (
    VoiceCallNotification,
    VoiceCallNotificationChannel,
    VoiceCallNotificationStatus,
)



class FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository(
    VoiceCallNotificationRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository port.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
    ):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        notification: VoiceCallNotification,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification:

        self.storage[
            notification.id
        ] = notification


        return notification



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCallNotification | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            notification_id
        )



    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        notification_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.storage.pop(
            notification_id,
            None,
        )



def create_repository():

    return (
        FakeVoiceCallNotificationRepository()
    )



def create_notification():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallNotification(
        id="notification-001",
        invitation_id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel=(
            VoiceCallNotificationChannel.INBOX
        ),
        status=(
            VoiceCallNotificationStatus.CREATED
        ),
        created_at=now,
    )



def test_save_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    result = repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    assert result.id == (
        "notification-001"
    )



def test_get_notification_by_id():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    stored = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="notification-001",
    )


    assert stored is not None


    assert stored.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )



def test_unknown_notification_returns_none():

    repository = create_repository()


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        notification_id="unknown",
    )


    assert result is None



def test_delete_notification():

    repository = create_repository()


    notification = create_notification()


    repository.save(
        notification=notification,
    )


    repository.delete(

def create_execution_context(
    *,
    state: VoiceCallState = VoiceCallState.READY,
) -> VoiceCallExecutionContext:
    """
    Create execution context.
    """


    session = VoiceCallSession(
        session_id="call-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        world_id="french_world",
        language_code="fr",
        state=state,
    )


    room = VoiceCallRoom(
        room_id="room-001",
        participants=(
            VoiceCallParticipant(
                participant_id="learner-001",
                role=VoiceParticipantRole.LEARNER,
                display_name="Learner",
            ),
            VoiceCallParticipant(
                participant_id="yeti",
                role=VoiceParticipantRole.CHARACTER,
                display_name="Yeti",
            ),
        ),
    )


    return VoiceCallExecutionContext(
        session=session,
        room=room,
    )



def create_coordinator() -> VoiceCallExecutionCoordinator:
    """
    Create coordinator with real
    application dependencies.
    """


    return VoiceCallExecutionCoordinator(
        room_service=VoiceRoomService(
            room_adapter=VoiceRoomAdapter(),
        ),
        execution_runtime=VoiceCallExecutionRuntime(),
    )



def test_start_prepares_room_and_executes_call():

    coordinator = create_coordinator()


    result = coordinator.start(
        context=create_execution_context(),
    )


    assert "room" in result


    assert "session" in result


    assert result["room"]["room_name"] == (
        "room-001"
    )


    assert result["room"]["provider"] == (

    result = coordinator.start(
        context=create_execution_context(),
    )


    participants = (
        result["room"]["participants"]
    )


    assert participants == [
        "learner-001",
        "yeti",
    ]



def test_execution_requires_ready_session():

        )

from datetime import (
    datetime,
    timedelta,

    VoiceCallInvitationRepository,

    VoiceCallInvitationStatus,
)



class FakeVoiceCallInvitationRepository(
    VoiceCallInvitationRepository,
):
    """
    Test implementation of repository port.
    """

    def __init__(self):

        self.storage = {}



    def save(
        self,
        *,
        invitation: VoiceCallInvitation,
    ) -> VoiceCallInvitation:

        self.storage[
            invitation.id
        ] = invitation

        return invitation



    def get_by_id(
        self,
        *,
        invitation_id: str,
    ) -> VoiceCallInvitation | None:

        return self.storage.get(
            invitation_id
        )



    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        invitation_id: str,
    ) -> None:

        self.storage.pop(
            invitation_id,
            None,
        )



def create_invitation():

    now = datetime.now(
        timezone.utc
    )


    return VoiceCallInvitation(
        id="inv-001",
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
        status=(
            VoiceCallInvitationStatus.CREATED
        ),
        created_at=now,
        expires_at=(
            now
            +
            timedelta(
                minutes=30
            )
        ),
    )



def create_repository():

    return (
        FakeVoiceCallInvitationRepository()
    )



def test_save_invitation():

    repository = create_repository()


    invitation = create_invitation()


    result = repository.save(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert result.id == (
        "inv-001"
    )



def test_get_invitation_by_id():

    repository = create_repository()


    invitation = create_invitation()


    repository.save(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        invitation_id="inv-001",
    )


    assert result is not None


    assert result.id == (
        invitation.id
    )


    assert result.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )



def test_get_unknown_invitation_returns_none():

    repository = create_repository()


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        invitation_id="unknown",
    )


    assert result is None



def test_delete_invitation():

    repository = create_repository()


    invitation = create_invitation()


    repository.save(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    repository.delete(
        invitation_id="inv-001",
    )


    result = repository.get_by_id(
        invitation_id="inv-001",
    )


    assert result is None

"""
Tests for Voice Call Invitation Service.

Validates:
- Invitation creation.
- Invitation lifecycle.
- Expiration handling.
- Repository dependency injection.
"""


from datetime import (
    timedelta,
)



from app.application.uai.voice.voice_call_invitation_service import (
    VoiceCallInvitationService,
)



from app.domain.uai.voice.voice_call_invitation import (
    VoiceCallInvitationStatus,
)



from app.infrastructure.persistence.in_memory_voice_call_invitation_repository import (
    InMemoryVoiceCallInvitationRepository,
)



def create_service():

    repository = (
        InMemoryVoiceCallInvitationRepository()
    )


    return (
        VoiceCallInvitationService(
            repository=repository,
        )
    )



def test_create_invitation():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
    )


    assert invitation.voice_call_id == (
        "vc-001"
    )


    assert invitation.learner_id == (
        "learner-001"
    )


    assert invitation.character_id == (
        "yeti"
    )


    assert invitation.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.CREATED
    )



def test_mark_invitation_sent():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="email",
    )


    sent = service.mark_sent(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert sent.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.SENT
    )



def test_accept_invitation():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
    )


    accepted = service.accept_invitation(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert accepted.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.ACCEPTED
    )



def test_expired_invitation_cannot_be_accepted():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="notification",
        expires_minutes=1,
    )


    expired_check_time = (
        invitation.expires_at
        +
        timedelta(
            minutes=1,
        )
    )


    assert invitation.is_expired(
        now=expired_check_time,
    )


    try:

        service.accept_invitation(
            invitation=invitation,
            now=expired_check_time,
        )


        assert False, (
            "Expired invitation was accepted"
        )


    except ValueError as exc:

        assert str(exc) == (
            "Invitation expired."
        )



def test_cancel_invitation():

    service = create_service()


    invitation = service.create_invitation(
        voice_call_id="vc-001",
        learner_id="learner-001",
        character_id="yeti",
        channel="email",
    )


    cancelled = service.cancel_invitation(
        invitation=invitation,
    )


    assert cancelled.status == (
        VoiceCallInvitationStatus.CANCELLED
    )
